Class OperatorInputStream

java.lang.Object
java.io.InputStream
org.apache.opendal.OperatorInputStream
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public class OperatorInputStream extends InputStream
Reads a byte range sequentially through an OperatorReader. Each stream owns its native iterator and must be closed independently of its source reader. Reading a closed stream throws IllegalStateException.
